split_policy: temporal groups of 25 frames, stratified by physical hand
notes: This is the first real training run over the 1200-sample V2 corpus.
Physical hand labels come from capture-session labels, not teacher handedness.
Teacher landmarks are pseudo-labels and are not independent human ground truth.
The model must be converted to a browser/on-device runtime format and benchmarked side-by-side before replacing the teacher.
